title: Duecare Live Demo Wheels

description: v3.6 / chat-package 0.2.0 (2026-05-06) — 21-dim rubric (added operational_information_provided + harm_enablement_check), use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename. v3.16 - wheels for the polished live-demo notebook. The headline +56.5pp lift demonstration runs end-to-end via the focused 4-card homepage (/individual / /enterprise / /knowledge / /settings).
